one_month_reasoning: No Salesforce earnings in the window (Q3 FY27 report expected early December 2026). In-window items: final settlement of the $25B ASR (October, mechanical, modest share-count reduction already expected), closing of the Contentful and Fin acquisitions (already in guidance), and read-across from peer prints in late October (ServiceNow ~Oct 21-22, Microsoft/Dynamics ~Oct 28-29) plus any Anthropic IPO/valuation headlines that mark Salesforce's stake. Peer read-across has been positive (NOW AI ACV >$1B, cRPO +21%) but Microsoft flagged CRM bookings moderating. Stock already rallied ~67% off the June trough and +23% on Q2, so no clear drift signal; I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred ~$232 with ~13% monthly vol (47%/3.5).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (15x NTM non-GAAP EPS ~$17.3 = $260), SBC-adjusted FCF yield (6.0% on ~$13B FY28 FCF less SBC, ~800M shares, = $272) and EV/NTM sales (4.3x ~$55B less ~$26B net debt = $263); weights 40/35/25 give ~$265, trimmed to $262 for seat-pricing risk flagged by peers.

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus FY28 normalized EPS ~$16.0; below FY27 guide $16.69 because FY27 includes ~$2.53 of one-off strategic investment gains (source 20).
FY28 $16.0 grown ~12%: ~10-11% revenue growth (FY30 $63B target path, Gartner CRM spend CAGR ~15%) plus lower share count; margin roughly flat at ~34%.

Stock trades ~14.4x FY28 consensus today ($231/$16.0) and ~16x per 247 Wall St; peers with faster growth (NOW +24%) trade far higher; modest re-rating as Agentforce ARR scales, capped by seat-compression debate.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY28 FCF ~$16.3B less SBC ~$3.3B = ~$13B; 6.0% yield; ~800M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: ~$15.1-15.5B FY27 grown ~7% with revenue, net of higher interest on $25B notes.
Approx. 7% of revenue per recent 10-Q run-rate; deducted as real cost.
821M diluted at Q2 minus final ASR delivery in Oct-2026 and ongoing buybacks.
Current unadjusted FCF yield ~7.5%; a 6% SBC-adjusted yield equals ~12-13x FCF, below large-cap software median, reflecting ~10% growth.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue ~$55B x 4.3x = $236B EV, less ~$26B net debt, /800M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Current EV ~$218B (mkt cap ~$190B + $27.9B net debt) = ~4.3x FY28 sales; held flat.
$27.9B at Jul-2026, modest paydown; Anthropic stake (~$5B, source 17) treated as partial offset/optionality not added.

bear.story: Peer evidence of seat compression spreads (Microsoft CRM bookings moderating, HubSpot/ServiceNow pricing concessions, outcome-based pricing undercutting per-seat); organic growth ex-M&A slips to ~7%, Agentforce monetization disappoints, leverage from debt-funded ASR weighs; ~11x FY29 EPS ~$15.

base.story: ~10-11% growth (partly acquired), 34% non-GAAP margin, Agentforce/Data 360 ARR keeps compounding; industry CRM spend grows low-teens; stock ~15x NTM EPS $17.

bull.story: Agentforce and Claudeforce drive organic reacceleration to low-teens, agentic AI spending (Gartner) accrues to the incumbent system of record; Anthropic IPO monetizes a multi-billion stake to retire ASR debt; ~19x FY29 EPS $18.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$165 (about 10x FY28 EPS and near the June 2026 trough region) the market would be pricing structural seat erosion or an organic growth stall in the single digits, i.e. the industry 'SaaSpocalypse' thesis winning rather than normal volatility; it would likely coincide with cRPO growth falling well below the ~14% guide.

catalysts.event: Final settlement of $25B ASR; Contentful and Fin acquisitions close
Microsoft FY27 Q1 results (Dynamics 365 CRM bookings)
Possible Anthropic IPO marking Salesforce's stake / debt paydown
Q4 FY27 earnings and FY28 guidance (approx.)

key_uncertainties: Whether agentic AI shrinks per-seat CRM revenue faster than Agentforce consumption revenue grows (peer pricing shifts at HubSpot/ServiceNow)
Quality of earnings: FY27 EPS inflated by ~$2.53 of investment gains; organic growth ex-Informatica/Contentful/Fin is closer to ~9-10%
Balance-sheet leverage (~$28B net debt) and use of Anthropic stake proceeds
Competition from ServiceNow CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, and AI-native service agents
Software sector multiple regime (Feb-2026 SaaS selloff vs Aug-2026 rebound)
reasoning: Industry lane: peers show AI expanding rather than killing incumbent platforms in 2026 (ServiceNow +24% revenue, AI ACV >$1B; HubSpot +20%), but pricing is moving from seat to meter/outcome (HubSpot outcome pricing, ServiceNow 50% of net new non-seat) and Microsoft says CRM bookings are moderating with longer cycles; IDC shows Salesforce holding ~20% share but slightly lagging market growth; Gartner projects CRM spend ~15% CAGR and agentic spend surging. Company facts: Q2 FY27 revenue +11%, cRPO +14%, FY27 guide $46.1-46.4B, non-GAAP EPS $16.67-16.71 inflated by investment gains; FY28 consensus ~$16.0; 821M diluted shares after a debt-funded $25B ASR; net debt ~$27.9B. Fair value ~$262 from P/E, SBC-adjusted FCF yield and EV/sales, ~13% above $231. Scenarios 160/255/340 at 25/50/25 give a mean ~$253. I model the 12-month distribution as roughly lognormal with median ~$248 and sigma ~0.40 (below the 47% realized vol, which was inflated by the Feb selloff and Aug earnings gap, but well above a typical large-cap), with slightly fattened tails. Research was limited to ~10 searches/fetches; several figures (FY28 consensus, SBC) are approximate.
